title: Binance Square Launches Live Trading: Direct Access to Trading Strategies
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, We are thrilled to announce the launch of Live Trading, a new innovative feature on Binance Square! The Live Trading feature allows users to watch creators and experienced traders through livestreams, to enhance their understanding and confidence in navigating the crypto markets.   Key Highlights of Live Trading This feature is part of our ongoing commitment to provide cutting-edge tools and resources to empower our community and make trading more accessible and engaging for users globally. Direct Strategy Access:  Users can connect with Binance Square creators and explore their trading strategies in real-time, enhancing their market insights. Global Engagement:  Live Trading is designed to enrich the trading journey for both seasoned traders and newcomers, fostering a deeper understanding of crypto markets. Interactive Learning:  By participating in Live Trading sessions, users can gain valuable knowledge and confidence in their trading activities. The Live Trading feature will be available on the Binance Website and App from  2025-05-26. Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More information: Live Trading on Binance Square — Trade Instantly During Crypto Livestreams Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-05-26
